## Work order (draft)

- **Title:** Suspected component A feed loss (stream 1), C header pressure loss (stream 4), and A/B/C feed composition variation (stream 4)
- **Priority:** High (gate status VERIFIED)
- **Suspected causes (approved, in order):**
  1. IDV(6) — component A feed loss, stream 1 (step)
  2. IDV(7) — component C header pressure loss, stream 4 (step)
  3. IDV(8) — component A, B, C feed composition variation, stream 4 (random variation)
- **Verified evidence (all items passed the deterministic gate):**
  - XMEAS(1) — down (component A feed, stream 1)
  - XMV(3) — up (component A feed flow valve position, stream 1)
  - XMEAS(20) — down (compressor work)
  - XMEAS(29) — down (component A in purge gas, stream 9)
- **Requested inspection** (per *inspection_guide_by_disturbance.md*; stream tags per *tep_process_description.md*):
  - **IDV(6) — component A feed loss (stream 1):**
    - Check the stream 1 supply: upstream isolation valves, header pressure, and supplier status.
    - Inspect the stream 1 flow transmitter and the feed valve.
    - Verify the stream 1 line for blockage or leakage.
  - **IDV(7) — C header pressure loss (stream 4):**
    - Measure the C header pressure at the field gauge.
    - Check the supply source and the pressure regulator on the C header.
    - Inspect the stream 4 feed valve and the flow transmitter.
  - **IDV(8) — A, B, C feed composition variation (stream 4):**
    - Sample the stream 4 feed over time and verify the composition variability.
    - Check the feed analyzer and the upstream mixing or blending point.
    - Verify the stream 4 flow transmitter for noise.

Findings are to be reported to the operator, who decides any control action under the plant procedures.

## Shift handover

The alarm is recorded at sample index 173; the exact clock time is not provided in the approved diagnosis. The approved diagnosis (gate status VERIFIED) lists IDV(6) component A feed loss in stream 1, IDV(7) C header pressure loss in stream 4, and IDV(8) A/B/C feed composition variation in stream 4, in that order. Confidence is high: agreement between samples is 1.00 and all four cited evidence items (XMEAS(1) down, XMV(3) up, XMEAS(20) down, XMEAS(29) down) passed the deterministic gate. No specific rejected evidence items are listed in the approved diagnosis message (not provided), so only the four verified tags above should be treated as support. Pending: maintenance field inspection of stream 1 supply, the C header, and the stream 4 feed per the inspection guide to confirm or rule out each cause; results go to the operator for the next decision under plant procedures.
